mettle.feedback.speech.caravan: Caravan Master · +10 %% carry on the road
mettle.perk.speech.appraiser.description: Item tooltips show what this settlement's market pays and asks for them; away from a market, what the nearest villager pays.
mettle.perk.speech.barterer.description: Piglins give one more item a quarter of the time, and a wandering trader restocks once more for you.
mettle.perk.speech.caravan_master.descri: You and allies within 8 blocks carry 10%% more on paths and roads.
mettle.perk.speech.charmer.description: Reputation you gain with Hearth folk +25%% (until Hearth reads it: your Presence counts 1 higher there).
mettle.perk.speech.commanding_voice.desc: Your Presence counts 2 higher wherever Hearth reads it, and allies within 8 blocks gain 5%% more skill XP.
mettle.perk.speech.glib.description: Your Speech counts %s higher wherever Hearth reads it (checks, haggling room, patience and the limit band); without Hearth, villagers' gossip about you grows 25 / 50 / 75%% faster.
mettle.perk.speech.golden_mouth.descript: Failed speech checks give full XP.
mettle.perk.speech.golden_mouth.hint: They came to argue and left agreeing.
mettle.perk.speech.haggler.description: Your market edge at Hearth is %s%% better, and villagers' trades of 4 or more emeralds cost 1 / 2 / 3 less.
mettle.perk.speech.heros_welcome.descrip: Hero of the Village after a raid you helped win lasts 3 in-game days, and Hearth folk greet you as a hero.
mettle.perk.speech.ledger_keeper.descrip: Speech XP from business never tapers, and coins you carry weigh nothing.
mettle.perk.speech.merchant_prince.descr: Your market edge at Hearth +5%%, and a merchant you walked away from is never sour with you (until Hearth reads it: 2%% more edge instead).
mettle.perk.speech.provisioner.descripti: Food, drink and potions: you buy 10%% cheaper and sell 10%% dearer at Hearth markets.
mettle.perk.speech.second_word.descripti: Once a sim day, a failed Hearth speech check may be tried again at once (until Hearth reads it: your Speech counts 1 higher).
mettle.perk.speech.shrewd_eye.descriptio: You read a Hearth merchant's limit band as if your Speech were 5 higher (until Hearth reads it: your market edge +2%%).
mettle.perk.speech.tavern_keeper.descrip: Food you cook in a furnace or smoker carries your name and sells 20%% dearer at Hearth markets.
mettle.perk.speech.the_courtiers_manners: Your Presence counts 2 higher wherever Hearth reads it.
Taught by a city's merchant, or found in A Treatise on Courtesy.
mettle.perk.speech.voice_of_the_realm.de: Your Speech counts 4 higher and your Presence 2 higher wherever Hearth reads them.
mettle.speech.appraise.none: No market near to price it
